title: Into My Mother's House
summary: This is the full integration: the Lord received now as kindred, sharing the same nourishment, the soul instructed in what bears it. The teachings unfold this fullness. They begin with the diagnosis of envy as the self's first motion of claim and the eight dwellings of living love; the Apostle's letter of peace and greeting between Call and Hearing, the kingdoms of the world, the four works of self-love met by the saving separation; the daily purification by which truth as nourishment cleanses what was mingled; the two faces shown forth in the rational — love and the strife being refined; the cosmic body and the soul as pearl in the sea; the soul's rest in the luminaries, the four ways up and the eight ways down, the elements stripped of their defiled garments and brought to first rest; the cloud and the three rising states, the pure soul tilled from above, the three modes of begetting; the Virgin and the Continent — soul never claimed and soul claimed-and-returned — the inverted face that signs the Call and the Answer, the five births of the body of which the soul recognizes only one; what endures and what passes, the word's articulation through five degrees, why the same ground bears sweet fruit and bitter; the five mysteries of the First Man and the hundred holy days, the hidden powers in the senses, the three forms in the eye and why understanding sees only by light; and at last the fivefold completeness without which the cosmos cannot stand, the gates open between the firmaments, and the three forms in the perfect man with the daily soul-cycle that purifies all three.
organizing_principle: The teachings unfold the full integration in one continuous arc. They open with the diagnostic dyad: envy as the first motion of the self that claims, love as the bond at every register where it can be received — the difference the soul has by now learned to feel. They then turn outward to the conversation between Lord and soul: the salutation as letter, the kingdoms as the last political shape of the self that claims, the four works of self-love met by saving separation. The arc turns inward to how light operates: daily purification, the two faces refined, the soul as pearl in the sea of body. The teachings then trace the rest: where the soul finds rest, the ways up and down, the elements stripped and at first rest; and then the bearing: the cloud-states that bear influx, the pure soul tilled from above, the three modes of begetting; and the recognition: virgin and continent, the inverted Call and Answer, the five hidden offspring; and the discriminations: what endures, the word minted through five faculties, sweet fruit and bitter from one ground. The deepest interior follows: five mysteries and the hundred days of the Call-Answer as living food, the hidden senses, the three forms in the eye. The close is the fivefold cosmos, the gates always open between degrees, and the three forms in the regenerated person with the daily cycle that purifies all three. This is the full integration that the earlier withdrawal had to make possible. It is the major culmination of the cycle. The final section will then seal what is here received.
